author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Paper Validation: Gen. Test (Combat w/ 1500 HVGs)
abstract: Generalization test for a future paper. This experiment applies the finding that 1500 HVGs is optimal to a simpler baseline (ComBat). It runs the standard ComBat algorithm but with `n_top_genes=1500`. If performance improves relative to the 2000 HVG ComBat baseline, it will demonstrate that the feature selection finding is general and not specific to the SOTA architecture.

original_submission.content:
import anndata as ad, scanpy as sc, numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import issparse
def _aprior(d): m=np.mean(d); s2=np.var(d); return (2*s2+m**2)/s2 if s2 > 0 else 1.0
def _bprior(d): m=np.mean(d); s2=np.var(d); return (m*s2+m**3)/s2 if s2 > 0 else 1.0
def _it_sol(s, g, d, gb, t2, a, b, c=1e-4):
    n=(~np.isnan(s)).sum(axis=1); go,do=g.copy(),d.copy(); chg=1; i=0
    while chg>c and i<100:
        gn=(t2*n*g+do*gb)/(t2*n+do); sm2=((s-gn.reshape(-1,1))**2).sum(axis=1); dn=(0.5*sm2+b)/(n/2.0+a-1.0)
        chg=max((abs(gn-go)/go).max(),(abs(dn-do)/do).max()); go,do=gn,dn; i+=1
    return go,do
def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # --- MODIFICATION: Changed n_top_genes ---
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, 1e4); sc.pp.log1p(adata)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, n_top_genes=1500, batch_key='batch', subset=True)

    dat = adata.X.toarray().T if issparse(adata.X) else adata.X.copy().T
    b=adata.obs['batch'].values; ub=np.unique(b); nb=len(ub); ng,ns=dat.shape
    bd=np.zeros((ns,nb)); bi=[]; [bi.append(np.where(b==bt)[0]) for i,bt in enumerate(ub)]; [np.put(bd[:,i],bi[i],1) for i in range(nb)]
    n_batches=np.array([len(i) for i in bi])
    bh=np.linalg.inv(bd.T@bd)@bd.T; gm=np.mean(dat,axis=1,keepdims=True); bm=(bh@dat.T).T
    vp=np.zeros(ng); [vp.__iadd__(np.sum((dat[:,i]-bm[:,j:j+1])**2,axis=1)) for j,i in enumerate(bi)]; vp/=(ns-nb)
    sm=gm@np.ones((1,ns)); s_dat=np.zeros_like(dat)
    [s_dat.__setitem__((slice(None),i),(dat[:,i]-bm[:,j:j+1])/np.sqrt(vp[:,np.newaxis]+1e-8)) for j,i in enumerate(bi)]
    gh=np.linalg.inv(bd.T@bd)@bd.T@s_dat.T; gh=gh.T
    dh=[np.var(s_dat[:,i],axis=1,ddof=1) for i in bi]
    gb=np.mean(gh,axis=1); t2=np.var(gh,axis=1,ddof=1)
    ap=[_aprior(d) for d in dh]; bp=[_bprior(d) for d in dh]
    gs,ds=[],[]; [gs.append(g) or ds.append(d) for i,idx in enumerate(bi) for g,d in [_it_sol(s_dat[:,idx],gh[:,i],dh[i],gb,t2,ap[i],bp[i])]]
    gs,ds=np.array(gs).T,np.array(ds).T
    bayesdata=s_dat.copy()
    [bayesdata.__setitem__((slice(None),bi[j]),(bayesdata[:,bi[j]]-(gs[:,j].reshape(-1,1)@np.ones((1,n_batches[j]))))/(np.sqrt(ds[:,j]).reshape(-1,1)@np.ones((1,n_batches[j])))) for j in range(nb)]
    bayesdata=bayesdata*(np.sqrt(vp).reshape(-1,1)@np.ones((1,ns)))+sm
    temp_adata = ad.AnnData(np.nan_to_num(bayesdata.T))
    sc.pp.pca(temp_adata, n_comps=50, svd_solver='arpack')
    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = temp_adata.obsm['X_pca']
    return adata
